overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（6 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（3 篇）、公司金融（2 篇）。方法上以实验方法、回归分析为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、Semantic Scholar（3 篇）、NBER（2 篇）。其中 2 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: RetailAgent: Structured Adverse Timing in Self-Conditioned Multimodal LLM Trading Agents
papers.abstract: In financial markets, a sequential policy that reacts systematically to price movements may become predictable to other market participants. This paper studies whether large language model (LLM) agents exhibit such directional structure through RetailAgent, an experimental framework in which an LLM observes anonymized intraday equity price histories and permitted state, then repeatedly chooses long (hold the stock) or flat (stay out) before the subsequent interval return is revealed. We compare returns during long and flat intervals along the same stock's intraday path after removing the overall fraction of long decisions. This exposure-matched measure reveals persistent negative timing across modality, horizon, state, and model family. Shuffling saved action sequences substantially attenuates the effect, showing that alignment between actions and subsequent returns drives the negative score. Feeding self-authored memories into decisions further increases policy persistence, while timing becomes more negative among stock-days on which the agent uses both actions. These results reveal stable, recoverable directional structure in sequential LLM financial decisions and a behavioral signal for studying how another participant could respond to a predictable policy.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在金融市场中，一种能够系统地根据价格变动做出反应的顺序决策策略可能会被其他市场参与者预测到。本文通过RetailAgent这一实验框架来研究大型语言模型（LLM）是否表现出这种方向性特征。在该框架中，LLM会观察经过匿名处理的日内股票价格历史数据以及允许的状态信息，然后在下一个时间间隔的收益公布之前反复选择“买入”（持有股票）或“持有观望”（不进行任何操作）。在排除了所有“买入”决策后，我们比较了同一股票日内不同时间段内的收益情况。这种基于暴露匹配的测量方法揭示了在不同模式、时间范围、状态和模型类型下，这种负向决策时序的普遍存在性。通过打乱决策序列可以显著减弱这种效应，表明决策与后续收益之间的关联性是导致负向评分的主要原因。将自动生成的记忆信息纳入决策过程会进一步增强策略的持续性；而在同时采用这两种策略的交易日中，这种负向时序现象更为明显。这些结果表明，LLM在金融决策中存在稳定且可识别的方向性特征，并为研究其他市场参与者如何应对可预测的策略提供了行为学依据。。研究方法：大语言模型、实验方法。

papers.title: Market-Informed Valuation of GMMB Riders with Surrender Options under a Heston Stochastic-Local Volatility Model
papers.abstract: We develop a market-informed valuation framework for   guaranteed minimum maturity benefit (GMMB) riders with   rational surrender under the Heston stochastic-local   volatility (SLV) model. The guarantee is written on the   fee-deducted account value and is considered both in its   terminal-only form and in the presence of early surrender   rights. The Heston SLV specification combines stochastic volatility with a leverage function calibrated to a prescribed local-volatility surface. The leverage surface is obtained through a forward Markovian-projection equation so that, at the model level, the SLV dynamics are constrained to the same one-dimensional marginals as the corresponding local-volatility (LV) model. The latter is used only as a one-factor benchmark, allowing us to isolate the effect of stochastic volatility on continuation values and surrender decisions while preserving the same option-calibrated local-volatility target. We derive the associated backward pricing equations and propose a hybrid tree/finite-difference algorithm for the SLV model with a calibrated leverage function. Synthetic experiments and a market-informed case study show that SLV and LV valuations are numerically close for terminal-only guarantees, as expected from the common marginal target, whereas materially larger differences can arise once surrender is allowed. These differences are reflected in guarantee values, fair insurance fees and volatility-dependent surrender regions. The results indicate that matching one-date marginals implied by vanilla-option prices does not eliminate model risk for insurance liabilities whose value depends on conditional continuation dynamics and endogenous surrender decisions.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们构建了一个基于市场信息的估值框架，用于评估在Heston随机局部波动率（SLV）模型下具有理性退保条款的保证最低到期收益（GMMB）期权。该保证条款针对扣除费用的账户价值进行设定，并考虑了仅限到期时的情况以及存在提前退保权利的情形。Heston SLV模型将随机波动率与一个根据预设的局部波动率曲面进行校准的杠杆函数相结合。该杠杆函数通过前向马尔可夫投影方程得到，从而在模型层面上确保SLV的动态受到与相应局部波动率（LV）模型相同的一维边际条件的约束。LV模型仅作为单一因素的基准，使我们能够在保持相同期权校准的局部波动率目标的同时，分离出随机波动率对期权存续价值及退保决策的影响。我们推导出了相关的逆向定价方程，并提出了一种适用于带有校准杠杆函数的SLV模型的混合树/有限差分算法。合成实验和市场案例研究表明，对于仅限到期的保证条款，SLV模型与LV模型的估值在数值上非常接近（这与它们共享的边际条件相符）；然而，一旦允许提前退保，两者之间的差异会显著增大。这些差异体现在保证价值、公平保险费用以及受波动率影响的退保区域上。研究结果表明，对于价值取决于条件存续动态和内生退保决策的保险负...。研究方法：广义矩估计、模型校准、实验方法、随机过程。

papers.title: Green finance–digital supply chain synergy and international logistics trade efficiency: evidence from China's Jing-Jin-Ji urban agglomeration
papers.venue: Journal of Applied Economics and Policy Studies
papers.abstract: This paper examines the impact of green finance–digital supply chain synergy on international logistics trade efficiency in the Jing-Jin-Ji region and explores the underlying mechanisms. Using panel data for 13 cities from 2013 to 2024, this study constructs green finance and digital supply chain indices based on the entropy weight method and measures their synergy using a coupling coordination degree model. International logistics trade efficiency is estimated through a super-efficiency DEA model, and a fixed-effects model is employed for empirical analysis. The results show that green finance, digital supply chains and their synergistic development exhibit an overall upward trend despite regional disparities. Green finance–digital supply chain synergy significantly improves international logistics trade efficiency, with stronger effects observed in regions with higher levels of development. Further analysis reveals that resource allocation efficiency and digital financial inclusion serve as important transmission channels. These findings provide new evidence on the role of financial and digital synergies in enhancing logistics performance and offer policy implications for promoting coordinated regional development and high-quality trade growth.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】本文研究了绿色金融与数字化供应链的协同效应对京津冀地区国际物流贸易效率的影响，并探讨了其背后的作用机制。利用2013至2024年间13个城市的面板数据，本研究基于熵权重方法构建了绿色金融和数字化供应链指数，并通过耦合协调度模型衡量了两者的协同作用。国际物流贸易效率通过超效率DEA模型进行估算，实证分析采用固定效应模型。研究结果表明，尽管存在区域差异，绿色金融、数字化供应链及其协同发展总体上呈现出上升趋势。绿色金融与数字化供应链的协同效应显著提升了国际物流贸易效率，且在发展水平较高的地区效果更为明显。进一步分析发现，资源配置效率和数字金融包容性是重要的传导渠道。这些发现为金融与数字化协同作用在提升物流绩效方面的作用提供了新的证据，并为促进区域协调发展和高质量贸易增长提供了政策启示。。研究方法：面板数据。

papers.title: Effect of Institutional Ownership on Audit Report Lag of Listed Non-Finance Firms in Nigeria
papers.venue: International Journal of Economics and Financial Management
papers.abstract:
This study investigated the effect of institutional ownership on audit report lag of listed nonfinance firms in Nigeria. The population of the study consists of all the 103 (one hundred and
three) drawn from all the selected non-finance firms listed on the floor of the Nigerian Exchange
Group (NGX). The study employed judgmental and non-probability sampling technique and the
sample size was seventy-seven (77). Both primary and secondary sources of data were explored.
Based on the nature of data collected, panel generalized method of moment analytical approach
was used. The results obtained from the Generalized Least Square regression analysis reveal that
institutional ownership [Coef. = 0.0012214 (P-value = 0.000)] had a positive effect on audit report
lag with respect to non-violator firms in Nigeria. This study concludes that timely financial
reporting is essential not only for reducing uncertainties and information asymmetry but to
enhance the overall efficiency of financial markets and strengthen stakeholder trust. This study
recommends that stakeholders should implement targeted policies that will balance the benefits of
institutional investors' scrutiny with the need for timely reporting. Regulatory bodies such as the
Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) should encourage institutional investors to adopt
more streamlined governance practices, including setting clear expectations for financial
reporting processes and collaborating with management to establish realistic yet efficient
timelines for audit completion. These measures would maintain the high-quality reporting
demanded by institutional investors while preventing unnecessary delays.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】本研究探讨了机构所有权对尼日利亚上市非金融企业审计报告延迟的影响。研究对象为尼日利亚证券交易所（NGX）上市的所有非金融企业中的103家。研究采用了判断抽样和非概率抽样方法，样本量为77家。研究同时收集了第一手和第二手数据，并根据数据性质选择了面板广义矩分析方法。广义最小二乘回归分析的结果表明，对于不违规的非金融企业而言，机构所有权（系数=0.0012214，P值=0.000）对审计报告的延迟具有正向影响。研究认为，及时披露财务信息不仅有助于降低不确定性、减少信息不对称，还能提升金融市场的整体效率并增强利益相关者的信任。研究建议相关利益方应制定相关政策，以平衡机构投资者监督的积极作用与企业及时报告的需求。监管机构（如证券交易委员会SEC）应鼓励机构投资者采用更规范的治理实践，包括明确财务报告流程的要求，并与企业管理层合作制定切实可行且高效的审计完成时间表。这些措施既能满足机构投资者对高质量报告的期望，又能避免不必要的延误。。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Fear as a Campaign Tool: Evidence from the 2014 U.S. Ebola Scare
papers.abstract: We study the supply of political communication highlighting perceived threats, using the 2014 Ebola scare as a natural experiment. Analyzing Twitter posts and congressional newsletters from US House and Senate candidates, we find Republicans increased Ebola-related communication, emphasizing negative sentiment and links to immigration. This response was strongest in safe Republican seats, consistent with base signaling. The supply side was active, not reactive: the Republican response did not vary with proximity to diagnosed cases despite concentrated voter anxiety, politician tweets predicted public Ebola activity but not vice-versa, and more intensive messaging correlated with better electoral outcomes, controlling for local conditions.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在感知到威胁的情况下政治传播的供给行为，以2014年的埃博拉疫情作为自然实验案例。通过分析美国众议院和参议院候选人的Twitter帖子及官方通讯，我们发现共和党人增加了与埃博拉疫情相关的信息传播，其中负面情绪和移民问题被重点强调。这种反应在共和党控制的安全选区最为显著，这与其选民基础的特征相符。共和党的信息传播行为属于主动发起的，而非被动应对：尽管选民焦虑情绪普遍存在，但其传播策略并未因病例分布的密集程度而改变；政治人物的推文能够预测公众对疫情的反应，但反之则不然；此外，在控制了当地因素后，更密集的信息传播与更好的选举结果之间存在正相关关系。。研究方法：自然实验、实验方法。

papers.title: Tariff-Dispersion Shocks: The Mean is the Variance
papers.abstract: This paper studies the joint behavior over time of the mean and dispersion of U.S. import tariff rates across goods at the HTS 6-digit level, as well as the macroeconomic consequences of the shocks that drive these two moments. We document that the cross-sectional mean and the cross-sectional dispersion of import tariffs move closely together over time. Using a state-space model, we find that both are driven primarily by common shocks, while mean- and dispersion-specific tariff shocks play a negligible role. Thus, effectively, there are no separate mean-tariff shocks or tariff-dispersion shocks; there are only mean-dispersion tariff shocks. These common shocks account for a sizable share of movements in imports and the trade balance but only a small fraction of movements in output. A positive transitory mean-dispersion tariff shock reduces the import-to-output ratio and improves the trade-balance-to-output ratio; a positive permanent mean-dispersion tariff shock also reduces the import-to-output ratio but has a muted effect on the trade-balance-to-output ratio. Positive transitory mean-dispersion tariff shocks are expansionary, whereas positive permanent mean-dispersion tariff shocks are contractionary in the short run and expansionary in the medium run.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本文研究了美国进口关税税率（以HTS 6位编码级别表示）的均值与离散度随时间的联合变化趋势，以及导致这两种变化的宏观经济冲击因素。研究发现，进口关税的横截面均值与离散度在时间上呈现出密切的同步变化。通过状态空间模型分析，我们发现这两种变化主要受共同冲击因素的驱动，而特定于关税均值或离散度的冲击因素影响甚微。因此，实际上并不存在独立的“均值关税冲击”或“关税离散度冲击”，只有“均值-离散度关税冲击”。这些共同冲击因素能够解释进口量和贸易平衡变化的较大比例，但对产出变化的影响相对较小。短暂的、正向的均值-离散度关税冲击会降低进口占产出的比例并改善贸易平衡占产出的比例；而永久性的、正向的均值-离散度关税冲击虽然也会降低进口占产出的比例，但对贸易平衡占产出的影响较为有限。短暂的、正向的均值-离散度关税冲击具有扩张性效应，而永久性的、正向的均值-离散度关税冲击在短期内具有收缩性效应，但在中长期内则具有扩张性效应。。研究方法：横截面分析。

papers.title: Causal Non-causal State Space Models and the Modelling of Financial Bubbles
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study causal non-causal state space models to model time series characterised by a local explosive increase followed by a sharp decrease such as stock prices. To motivate the use of causal non-causal state space models, we show that the causal non-causal convolution autoregressive model introduced by Gourieroux and Zakoian (2017) can be consistent with the rational expectations stock price model. As in a causal state space model, a central question is how to perform state and parameter inference in the causal non-causal state space model, which we discuss in the paper. We also study the causal non-causal convolution autoregressive model in more detail, providing some new results for the model. To illustrate the usefulness of causal non-causal state space models, we use the causal non-causal convolution autoregressive model to estimate the size of the dot-com bubble in both real time and a posteriori with the stable non-causal autoregressive model considered also by Gourieroux and Zakoian (2017) as a benchmark.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在本文中，我们研究了因果非因果状态空间模型，用于描述那些具有局部剧烈上涨后紧接着急剧下跌特征的时间序列数据，例如股票价格。为了论证因果非因果状态空间模型的实用性，我们证明了Gourieroux和Zakoian（2017）提出的因果非因果卷积自回归模型可以与理性预期股票价格模型保持一致。与因果状态空间模型类似，一个核心问题是如何在该模型中进行状态和参数的推断，这也是本文讨论的重点。我们还对因果非因果卷积自回归模型进行了更深入的研究，并得出了该模型的一些新结论。为了展示因果非因果状态空间模型的有效性，我们利用该模型实时估计了互联网泡沫的规模，并通过Gourieroux和Zakoian（2017）提出的稳定非因果自回归模型作为基准，对估计结果进行了事后验证。。研究方法：时间序列。

papers.title: A Design Concept of Forecasting Software for Normalized Vector Autoregressions with Fat Tails and Stochastic Volatility
papers.abstract: We present a suite of R packages for macroeconomic forecasting that leverages advanced Bayesian, structural, multivariate, dynamic, hierarchical, non-linear, and non-Gaussian models. The suite enables both structural and predictive analyses, and is adapted to time series data across various types, dimensions, and sampling frequencies. Each additional feature increases computational complexity. To address this challenge, our software design incorporates a carefully curated selection of models, efficient algorithms implemented in C++, advanced econometric and numerical methods, robust handling of complex input and output objects, and standardised workflows. This approach combines the computational efficiency of C++ with the convenience of working with data in R. We demonstrate that our packages facilitate original research contributions in forecasting, as illustrated by our example in which vector autoregressions with non-centred stochastic volatility enhance density and point predictions relative to models with centred stochastic volatility.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们开发了一套用于宏观经济预测的R语言软件包，这些软件包融合了先进的贝叶斯模型、结构模型、多元模型、动态模型、层次模型、非线性模型以及非高斯模型。该软件包支持结构分析和预测分析，并适用于各种类型、维度和采样频率的时间序列数据。然而，每增加一项功能都会提升计算复杂性。为应对这一挑战，我们的软件设计采用了精心挑选的模型、用C++实现的高效算法、先进的经济计量学和数值方法、对复杂输入输出数据的稳健处理机制以及标准化的工作流程。这种设计将C++的高计算效率与R语言的数据处理便捷性相结合。我们的案例表明，这些软件包能够促进原创性的预测研究：具体来说，采用非中心化随机波动性的向量自回归模型相较于使用中心化随机波动性的模型，在密度估计和点预测方面具有更优的表现。。研究方法：时间序列、向量自回归、回归分析、贝叶斯方法、随机过程。

papers.title: The Race for Elite Destinations: Education Competition and Low Fertility in Korea
papers.abstract: South Korea has the world's lowest fertility and an intense education race. Families devote nine percent of lifetime income to education, mostly to private tutoring with near-zero measured returns. I show that competition for coveted careers generates an assignment externality: when all families spend more, the admission bar rises and children become costly. In a quantitative model calibrated to this mechanism, replacing score-based assignment with a capacity-preserving lottery raises completed fertility by 0.24 children per couple. Pronatal transfers deliver one eighth of that increase. Education taxes deliver almost none. Preference shifts, not a fiercer race, explain the decline across cohorts.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】韩国的生育率位居全球最低水平，同时教育竞争也异常激烈。家庭将一生收入的9%用于教育支出，其中大部分用于私人辅导，但这类辅导的实际回报几乎为零。研究表明，对热门职业的竞争会产生一种“分配外部性”：当所有家庭都增加教育投入时，入学门槛会提高，抚养孩子的成本也随之上升。在一个根据这一机制进行校准的定量模型中，将基于成绩的招生方式改为基于个人能力的抽签制度，每对夫妇的生育率可提高0.24个孩子；而通过生育补贴实现的生育率提升仅占这一增幅的八分之一；教育税收对生育率的提升作用几乎可以忽略不计。导致生育率下降的原因主要是人们偏好的变化，而非教育竞争的加剧。。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: Countervailing Curation Strategic Disclosure and the Design of Attention
papers.abstract: Opposing advocates may be unable to fabricate evidence but can choose which true observations to present. We study how a court, editor, or platform should divide potential exposure between an advocate who prefers a higher decision and one who prefers a lower decision. Each advocate controls a separate evidence pool, exposure is committed before the state and evidence are known, and a selection-naive receiver averages displayed observations. Under baseline linear preferences and common knowledge of the realized pools, all Nash equilibria in every finite pool induce the same action and common disclosure bar: the upward advocate reveals observations above it and the downward advocate those below it. Attention therefore changes selection as well as weight. Under a common evidence law, more exposure makes an advocate speak less often and more extremely while moving the decision in its preferred direction. In large pools, the unique state-contingent exposure share that reproduces the complete-evidence decision balances the advocates' directional tail moments, not their observed speech. Because this share generally depends on the unknown state, we characterize the optimal ex ante compromise and solve a primitive two-state economy with a unique second-best policy. For finite pools, we derive the exact risk-minimizing adjustment, separating selection-induced cutoff bias, the receiver's fixed benchmark, and sampling variance. The attention-to-cutoff feedback survives partial weighting of empty slots and vanishes at full imputation.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】。论文标题：Countervailing Curation Strategic Disclosure and the Design of Attention。摘要概述：该研究围绕「Economics、Finance」相关议题展开，属于金融经济学方向的研究。。结论要点：已基于原文英文摘要提炼主题信息，建议结合原文获取精确结论与量化结果。。

papers.title: Strong Observable Substitutability and the Cumulative Offer Mechanism
papers.abstract: We study the properties of the cumulative offer mechanism (COM) when institutions' choice functions satisfy strong observable substitutability (strong OS). First, we show that each of the following properties of the COM characterizes strong OS: IR monotonicity, weak Maskin monotonicity, and dropping monotonicity. Dropping monotonicity is a new condition weaker than weak Maskin monotonicity, and it is interpretable as a weakening of strategy-proofness and non-bossiness. Second, we show that when choice functions are strongly OS, weak group strategy-proofness of the COM reduces to individual strategy-proofness. However, strong OS is neither necessary nor "almost necessary" for this reduction.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】。论文标题：Strong Observable Substitutability and the Cumulative Offer Mechanism。摘要概述：该研究围绕「Economics、Finance」相关议题展开，属于金融经济学方向的研究。。结论要点：已基于原文英文摘要提炼主题信息，建议结合原文获取精确结论与量化结果。。

papers.title: Corporate Finance Theory and Profitability of Manufacturing Companies in Nigeria
papers.venue: International Journal of Economics and Financial Management
papers.abstract:
This study examined the relationship between corporate finance theory (CFT) and the
profitability of manufacturing companies in Nigeria. Using a panel dataset of 15
manufacturing firms on the Nigerian Exchange Group (NGX) from 2018 to 2022, the study
employed descriptive statistics, Pearson Product Moment Correlation (PPMC), and panel
regression analysis to determine the extent to which these variables influence firm profitability.
The findings revealed significant positive relationship between capital budgeting practices and
profitability. Capital structure also showed a modest but positive influence on profitability.
Working capital management had the strongest impact on profitability among the variables.
The study concludes that integrated and theory-driven financial decision making significantly
enhances the profitability of manufacturing firms in Nigeria. It recommends that corporate
managers adopt rigorous capital budgeting techniques, maintain an optimal capital structure,
and prioritize working capital efficiency. Policymakers and financial regulators are also
encouraged to promote best practices in corporate financial management to foster sustainable
firm performance and industrial growth in the Nigerian economy.
